# Zqvorchard sample repository

Seeded, invented code for the Phase 2 end-to-end test (`server/tests/e2e/`). Nothing here
is real. Every identifier, comment and file name carries the `zqv` canary, which appears
nowhere else in the project, so the privacy scan can look for it in every store. The
test adds a git-ignored file and a secret at run time, so neither is committed.

## Zqvorchard ledger

The ledger records zqvharvest crates per orchard row and reports the zqvyield total.
